target_customer: Pharma and biotech clinical development teams, and diagnostic partners, who pay for patient selection and disease trajectory predictions
problem: Clinical trials fail often and cost a great deal, partly because sponsors cannot predict which patients will progress or respond. Blank Bio trains RNA foundation models on tumour transcriptome data to inform those decisions.
business_model: Applied AI research lab selling model access and collaborations to pharma and diagnostics; revenue plan not disclosed by the CEO
product_category: RNA foundation models for precision oncology and clinical trial design

founders.name: Jonny Hsu
founders.background_notes: Biochemist by training. Early employee at Valence Discovery where he led product and strategy; Valence was acquired by Recursion in May 2023. Press calls him Jonathan Hsu.

founders.name: Philip Fradkin
founders.background_notes: One of the first employees at Deep Genomics. Co-developed the Orthrus RNA model during his PhD.

founders.name: Ian Shi
education: University of Toronto, PhD in computer science
founders.background_notes: Published at ICML, NeurIPS and Nature Communications. Interned at Pinterest and Amazon as a research scientist.

competitors.name: Deep Genomics
competitors.what: AI platform for RNA biology, with RNA foundation models and the REPRESS model for miRNA binding
competitors.traction_then: Established company; REPRESS released openly for non commercial use

competitors.name: Kerna Labs
competitors.what: AI platform using RNA foundation models to design mRNA medicines (design, not trial prediction)

technical_complexity.rationale: Training a 3B parameter RNA foundation model (Ladon) on RNA-seq data needs scarce ML plus biology talent and large curated datasets, though the team had already published the Orthrus model.

defensibility.rationale: Model quality and published research help, and the PacBio collaboration to generate new long-read data could add proprietary data, but foundation model methods are widely known and pharma buyers can build in house.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent had copied or bought the wedge by late 2026 in the sources found; the company is a young seed stage lab.

market_need_then: Pharma loses large sums on failed trials, and the company frames patient selection and disease trajectory prediction as the unmet need. Cheaper sequencing and foundation model methods made RNA modelling feasible by 2025.

branding.domain_note: Uses blank.bio, a .bio domain, per the company website

identity.visual_style: Direct and concise site with bold labels and clear calls to action
identity.voice_and_tone: Plain and scientific, framed around expensive trial failures

brand_strength.rationale: Early stage with press coverage of the seed round but no evidence of brand driven awareness; the name is generic and shares words with other brands.

outcome_analysis: Blank Bio is an active, very young company. After the Summer 2025 batch it raised a $7.2M oversubscribed seed in May 2026 and announced a PacBio sequencing collaboration. Founders carry direct RNA model research credentials from Toronto and ex Deep Genomics and Recursion experience, which supports founder market fit. The open questions are revenue model and whether pharma will pay for model predictions.
notes: No outcome news found beyond the seed round. Company website says RNA intelligence for precision oncology while the YC one liner says precision medicine. CEO first name appears as Jonny and Jonathan. A press summary says the company was established in 2025.
